degeneracy_reason: one or more readiness preconditions failed: arm_statistics_not_degenerately_bit_identical=False; yoked_arms_preserved_by_construction_fraction=False

interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation.summary: Substrate/arm readiness gate did not clear -- see interpretation.preconditions. Excluded seeds: {}. NOTE: RV(INTACT) still bit-identical to RV(IEI_PERMUTE) at every valid seed DESPITE use_per_region_vs=True -- this confirms the pair-specific reach check (Q081-REACH-CHECK-PAIR-SPECIFIC) is genuinely required; the blanket use_anchor_sets/use_per_region_vs flag reach is insufficient for this pair.

preconditions.name: landmark_arm_behavioural_reach
preconditions.description: assert_behavioural_reach(strict): boundary stream must reach (z_world, operating_mode) via REACH_CONSUMERS. 838 enables BOTH use_anchor_sets (z_world, MECH-269) AND use_per_region_vs (operating_mode via apply_invalidation_broadcasts_to_regions -> vs_rollout_gate -> E3) -- the 2026-07-28 V3-EXQ-824a autopsy fix.

preconditions.name: arm_statistics_not_degenerately_bit_identical
preconditions.description: 824/824a defect guard: RV(INTACT) must NOT be bit-identical to RV(IEI_PERMUTE) at every valid seed. Exact float64 equality across independently-simulated seeds is the confirmed signature of the manipulation never reaching the measured pair (824a's wall: it reached z_world but not operating_mode), not landmark-invariance. If this fails despite use_per_region_vs=True, the pair-specific reach check (Q081-REACH-CHECK-PAIR-SPECIFIC) is genuinely required.
preconditions.control: use_per_region_vs=True gives operating_mode reach (824a lacked it)

preconditions.name: yoked_arms_preserved_by_construction_fraction
preconditions.description: Fraction of seeds where BOTH yoked arms (iei_permute, circular_shift) held Level-1 preservation (count/IEI-multiset/posterior-multiset/scale-mix) exactly, per preservation_report.
preconditions.control: yoked arms replay a rearrangement of INTACT's own multiset

preconditions.name: yoked_arms_input_statistics_preserved_fraction
preconditions.description: Fraction of seeds where Level-2 input_statistics_divergence found no breach for BOTH yoked arms (the closed-loop confound check). A breaching seed is CONFOUNDED, not a null, and is excluded.

preconditions.name: sufficient_valid_seeds_for_delta_sd
preconditions.description: At least 2 seeds must clear every precondition above (admissible primary, artefact ruled out, iei_permute preserved + unconfounded) to compute an SD of the INTACT-minus-IEI_PERMUTE delta.

dissociation.interpretation: If the coupling drops under iei_permute (alignment destroyed) but is LARGELY PRESERVED under circular_shift (landmark-train internal structure kept, only rigid-shifted), the primary statistic was reading cross-stream ALIGNMENT. If it drops equally under both, the drop may reflect loss of the landmark train's own structure rather than its alignment. NOT load-bearing; circular_shift is the conservative secondary, not the discriminator.

interpretation_rules: Clearing the surrogate null is NECESSARY and NOWHERE NEAR SUFFICIENT for Outcome A -- wired coordination clears it correctly.
A statistic that SURVIVES the landmark-removal arm was measuring the clock -- Outcome B evidence, NOT support for the claim.
Neither control, nor both together, is the ablation series, which remains the only full A-vs-B discriminator.
The SUPPRESS arm is a LESION reference (removes the drive as well as the alignment); reported for context, never the discriminator.
interpretation.outcome_taxonomy_note: This design adjudicates ONLY Outcome A vs Outcome B. Outcome C (unrelated) is partially visible in per-seed rv_p_value_vs_surrogate on the INTACT arm. Outcomes D (too-much-sharing-collapses) and E (event-relative beats clock-relative, incl. sleep-phase structure) need different comparator arms and are deferred to a lettered follow-up.

criteria.name: C_ablation_delta_clears_effect_size_floor
criteria.note: PRIMARY discriminator: RV(INTACT) - RV(IEI_PERMUTE). effective_floor = max(1.5 * sd_delta=0.0000, 0.03) = 0.0300; project convention scales noise on the SD of the DELTA between arms, never the SD of either arm alone.
